lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 6-7 distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits, displaying a regular grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows, forming a series of rectangular grid nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible; the primary dorsal ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs localized primarily within the lower half of the first dorsal fin's trailing edge silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density and smaller diameter of high-luminance spots relative to the primary lateral flank pattern.
